# G+N Health

> > G+N Health is a UK-based medical supplier specializing in FITLEGS compression socks and Cryon-X cryotherapy recovery systems for clinical and everyday wellness applications.

G+N Health, operating under the heritage of Griffiths & Nielsen Ltd, offers MHRA-regulated medical compression hosiery and advanced recovery technology. The site serves healthcare professionals, athletes, pregnant individuals, and patients requiring therapeutic compression or post-injury rehabilitation.

- FITLEGS compression socks
